About the Scholarship

EACH is the Erasmus Mundus master in analytical chemistry coordinated by the University of Tartu with partner universities in Finland, Sweden and France. For the 2027 intake the first admission period runs from 5 November 2026 to 5 January 2027 (23:59 EET), and this is the window in which Erasmus Mundus scholarship decisions are made.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

EACH is the Erasmus Mundus master in analytical chemistry coordinated by the University of Tartu with partner universities in Finland, Sweden and France. For the 2027 intake the first admission period runs from 5 November 2026 to 5 January 2027 (23:59 EET), and this is the window in which Erasmus Mundus scholarship decisions are made.

Programme Highlights

  • Two admission periods, with the scholarship decision tied to the November-January window
  • Strong tradition in green analytical chemistry and measurement science
  • Mobility across Tartu, partner universities and an industry-linked thesis
  • Graduates work in pharma QA, environmental labs and metrology institutes

Who Should Apply

Chemistry and closely related graduates with solid quantitative analysis fundamentals; English documentation follows the University of Tartu's standard requirements via the DreamApply portal.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected applicants in admission period 1: tuition coverage plus a monthly allowance.

Deadline and How to Apply

Submit on the Estonian DreamApply portal between 5 November 2026 and 5 January 2027 (23:59 EET) for scholarship consideration. Key deadline information: 5 January 2027 (23:59 EET); admission period 1 runs 5 November 2026 – 5 January 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EACH Consortium (University of Tartu)

The EACH consortium is coordinated by the University of Tartu and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Excellence in Analytical Chemistry with European partners and an industry-connected internship semester.

Official website: https://each.ut.ee

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 5 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
